lines.quote: Trump winning means no war.
lines.subject: siegfriedmuell
lit: War is simply not in the cards
lines.why: Says Trump's win causes no war, and forecasts no war across his term.

lines.quote: Anyone talking about war with Iran is just out to lunch.
lines.subject: siegfriedmuell
lines.why: Dismisses war talk as baseless, which takes the no-war side.

lines.quote: Israel going to war with Iran without us is somehow proving me wrong?
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: Israel going to war with Iran without us
lines.why: Counters the charge: Israel fighting alone is not a US war, so the no-US-war claim still stands.

lines.quote: So, no war with Iran, no nukes. Wake me up when that changes
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: States that there is no war and no nukes at present.

lines.quote: until then, I'm right yet again
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: A claim about the speaker's own record, not the object.

lines.quote: we would be "dying for Israel" and have "boots on the ground" in Iran. That didn't happen - that WONT happen
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Says the feared costs of US entry (dead Americans, ground troops) have not come and will not.

lines.quote: You're just missing the bigger picture here.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Directed at what others claim and miss, not at the object's condition.

lines.quote: Many of us made our voices loud and clear that we didn't want to be embroiled in a forever war in the Middle East - but it was in good faith!
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: made our voices loud and clear
lines.why: Defends the speaker's own side's past record and motives.

lines.quote: Many denouncing Trump and MAGA were doing so because they're personally invested in seeing the administration fail.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Attributes motives to critics; this is blame, not a reading of the object.

lines.quote: Can I get a war with Iran update?
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: A bare request for news that states nothing about where the war stands.

lines.quote: You guys had all those big spaces and posts about regime change, nuclear strikes and Americans dying for Israel.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Points to what others predicted earlier, which is about their record.

lines.quote: No "war with Iran."
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Says there is no war with Iran, a no-war reading, though the US had struck Iran eleven days earlier.

lines.quote: we got the biggest ever increase in ICE and border funding possible. Thank you TRUMP!
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: biggest ever increase in ICE and border funding
lines.why: Credits Trump for immigration funding, a matter of loyalty and credit that no body series measures.

lines.quote: If there's a single US boot dropped on Iran during Trump's presidency, I'll make a video denouncing the entire MAGA movement.
lines.subject: captivedreamer7
lit: single US boot dropped on Iran
lines.why: A conditional pledge about the speaker's own loyalty, tied to a course the line says nobody is on.

lines.quote: Immigration is the greatest issue we face in the West.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: greatest issue we face in the West
lines.why: A priority claim about immigration that sits off the body and says nothing about the Iran war's condition.

lines.quote: All of these people listed are pro immigration. I don't care if they're "based anti zionists" - they're the enemy
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Labels others as enemies by loyalty and position, not by any reading of the object.

lines.quote: Of course there are no "boots on the ground" in Iran
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: no "boots on the ground" in Iran
lines.why: Says the war involves no ground troops, which downplays it, even though it began that day.

lines.quote: these liars know this, they just want to score internet points for headpats from cult leader figures
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Attacks the motives of critics, which is blame and not a reading of the war.

lines.quote: I think boots on ground would be a big mistake and still do!
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: boots on ground would be a big mistake
lines.why: Weighs a course the line itself says nobody is on, and says nothing of where things stand.

lines.quote: But we have to see how this plays out.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: we have to see how this plays out
lines.why: A wait-and-see stance that takes no side.

lines.quote: Of course there are no boots on the ground in Iran, but even if there were, I don't care anymore.
lines.subject: captivedreamer7
lit: no boots on the ground in Iran
lines.why: Says there are no ground troops and drops the earlier boots pledge, accepting the war.

lines.quote: As long as He controls immigration, I don't care what happens.
lines.subject: captivedreamer7
lit: As long as He controls immigration
lines.why: Declares loyalty to a leader over outcomes, which is not a reading of the object.

lines.quote: I'm skeptical of these strikes
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Doubts the strikes now under way, leaning against the war.

lines.quote: we should in no universe have boots on the ground in Iran
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: no universe have boots on the ground
lines.why: Rejects a course the line says is not being taken, so it names no present condition.

lines.quote: let's hope this resolves quickly
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: A hope with no claim about where things stand.

lines.quote: I'm willing to give Trump the benefit of the doubt.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: States the speaker's own stance toward Trump, which is a matter of loyalty.

lines.quote: The price one pays for nuance on this app:
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: The price one pays for nuance
lines.why: A complaint about how the speaker is treated online, not about the war.

lines.quote: All these people do is lie
lines.subject: captive_dreamer, speaking of opponents
lit: All these people do is lie
lines.why: A charge about who is to blame and who is honest, not about the state of the war.

lines.quote: now that it's happening I hope it is resolved quickly and we can move onto other things
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: I hope it is resolved quickly
lines.why: A hope for a quick end; it names no condition of the war and takes no side.

lines.quote: I think it would be a massive mistake for some boots on the ground invasion of Iran
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: It weighs a course the speaker says nobody is on, so it takes no side.

lines.quote: Clearly that's not happening and there's very little chance it will happen.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: It says there is no ground invasion and little chance of one, but does not say where the war stands, so no side.

lines.quote: I explicitly opposed the Iran war from the outset
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: The speaker's own record on the war, not the war's condition.

lines.quote: didn't call any reasonable critics "third worldists." This is very disappointing to see from you.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: very disappointing to see from you
lines.why: A dispute over what the speaker did or said and a rebuke of another person; blame, not the object.

lines.quote: The people attacking me daily were these
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Says who attacked the speaker; a blame and loyalty claim.

lines.quote: the Zioshills hate me too
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: A claim about who opposes the speaker; loyalties, not the object.
